text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since Sweep Tosho didn't show up for training,
I searched all over, only to finally find her
in the library once evening came."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, if it isn't my familiar.
Did you need something?
choice_data_list: I thought we had training today.
I thought we were supposed to have training today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not like I forgot!
I was just a little busy practicing my magic,
that's all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hold on right there!
I'll use magic to turn back time before training!
I definitely will!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Smoky Orange Reversal!
Smoky Orange Reversaaal!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Turn back time already! You're so cheeky!
Fluffy Orange Reversal——!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her desperately trying to use magic, she seemed aware that she had done something wrong, so I simply told her to be more careful in the future.
